NETWORK.NAME: LAI_Indication_Choice_R5_draft
NETWORK.PROPERTY: label=lai indication and choice R5 draft network
clinical_validity=none; reference tables are synthetic structural placeholders, not patient estimates
ordering_contract=child state fastest, last declared parent next, first parent slowest

choice_scope=product-level consideration only; Table 8 conversions/overlaps/loading, Table 9 pharmacokinetics, injection technique, and missed-dose handling are labeling/physician domain, never network nodes

VARIABLE.NAME: SchizophreniaConfirmed
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician-confirmed schizophrenia for this review. not_confirmed_assessed means assessed and not confirmed; unknown_incomplete means diagnosis partial, bypassed, or otherwise unavailable, never a negative.

VARIABLE.NAME: LAIPreference
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Current informed preference after discussion of LAI pluses/minuses. prefers_oral means preference without explicit refusal; explicit refusal is declines_lai. undecided means assessed ambivalence. unknown_incomplete means undocumented or unasked, never oral preference and never consent.
source=STATEMENT-10 Patient Preferences; field proposed, not collected

VARIABLE.NAME: AdherenceHistory
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician assessment of antipsychotic adherence history from dated report, dispensing/administration records and collateral where available. uncertain means assessed uncertainty, not an unreviewed chart. Local window and criteria unresolved.

VARIABLE.NAME: DiscussionContext
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician identifies a contextual reason for LAI discussion: oral nonresponse with possible unrecognized gaps; care transition with future-adherence concern; early illness, limited treatment awareness, or substance-use-related adherence concern; repeated hospitalizations or emergency visits. Record which reason and dates. Prompts discussion only; never added to the formal indication and never proof of nonadherence.
source=STATEMENT-10 Implementation + Quality Measurement Considerations; field proposed, not collected

VARIABLE.NAME: CandidateReadiness
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=For the specific candidate antipsychotic: prior oral efficacy and tolerability both supported, either with a recorded concern (concern takes precedence), or supporting evidence not established after review. unknown_incomplete is unreviewed history, not missing input mapped to negative. Typical oral-first trial is guidance, not a universal hard contraindication. No dose, duration, or level is recorded.
source=STATEMENT-10 Implementation; reconciled drug-only medication history + history prior response/tolerability (awaiting_review)

VARIABLE.NAME: PriorNMSHistory
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Documented history of neuroleptic malignant syndrome. absent_assessed means assessed absence; missing history stays unknown_incomplete. Does not assess current NMS and never replaces urgent medical assessment. Caution, not an absolute contraindication.

VARIABLE.NAME: ProductPlanReviewed
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician/pharmacist has reviewed the candidate product plan against current local labeling: LAI availability, any needed medication switch, conversion-table pointer, oral overlap or loading pointer, injection route/site/interval, preparation/storage, safe injection, product-specific observation/monitoring, missed-dose instructions. yes means reviewed, never approved or suitable. No dose values are stored in this flag.
source=STATEMENT-10 Implementation; encounter attestation proposed, not collected

VARIABLE.NAME: DeliveryBarriers
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Assessed access barriers: transportation, scheduling, childcare, cost/authorization, injection staffing/training, space or resources. absent_assessed means none identified after assessment, never evidence of suitability.
source=STATEMENT-10 Implementation; field proposed, not collected

VARIABLE.NAME: LAITreatmentStatus
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Current LAI use takes precedence; previous means past LAI use without current use; considering means never treated with an LAI. Review concerns a specified candidate product; prior use of another agent never establishes candidate tolerability. Derived from drug identity only, never dose or dates of administration.
source=STATEMENT-10 Implementation + Patient Preferences; reconciled drug-only medication history

VARIABLE.NAME: LAIIndication
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Posterior over the formal 2B indication: confirmed schizophrenia AND (prefers LAI OR poor/uncertain adherence). not_established is not a contraindication and not a recommendation against LAI. Explicit refusal never negates the indication; refusal is respected in the template pathway.
source=STATEMENT-10 recommendation sentence; BN-10 LAIGuidelineCriterion lead

VARIABLE.NAME: LAIDiscussionPrompt
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Posterior over discussion posture: discuss the LAI option, consider a contextual discussion outside the formal indication, or offer routine education (routine education remains possible without a criterion). Never an initiation order.
source=STATEMENT-10 Implementation + Quality Measurement Considerations; BN-10 DiscussionOpportunity lead

VARIABLE.NAME: ClinicalSafetyReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Posterior over the clinical review focus: prior-NMS individualized caution; candidate efficacy/tolerability concern; establish candidate evidence; candidate evidence reviewed. Priority display only; all input findings are retained and no output certifies suitability.

VARIABLE.NAME: DeliveryReviewFocus
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Posterior over delivery review needs: product-plan review, barrier resolution, or items documented. Rendered in parallel with clinical review and discussion, never hidden. Documented items never authorize administration.

VARIABLE.NAME: LAIProductConsideration
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Posterior over 9 repeat-dosing Table 7 LAI products plus DeferredChoice. Consideration states only: no posterior maximum selects, ranks, doses, or recommends a product. DeferredChoice means no specific product is put forward under the reviewed rendering condition (no indication, explicit refusal, current-LAI individualized review, or uncertain preference/exposure). Aristada Initio (initiation-only) is excluded from choice states for review.
source=STATEMENT-04 Table 7 (availability); provisional identifiers pending catalog release
